title: Agentic Apps: the doors
lede: Agentic Apps is the resource layer — the things agents reach: registered MCP apps (/<app>/mcp), A2A agents, and LLM providers fronted by the AI Gateway. You cannot issue a grant without an app to point at.

steps.title: Register a door
steps.what: Register MCP servers and A2A agents behind the agentless gateway, with auth modes (Static Token vs Pass Agent Token), tool lists and guardrails.

steps.title: Aggregate if the surface sprawls
steps.what: An aggregate app composes several backends behind one door, so one grant can cover a whole composed surface.

steps.title: LLM providers are apps too
steps.what: Model providers sit behind the AI Gateway. Privilege holds the real provider key and injects it server-side; the agent's key is virtual.

steps.title: Every grant needs an app
steps.what: A key or federated identity is authorized per-app (and per-tool) — always by pointing at an app. No app, no grant. That is why this is section 2 of the console.
